newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland - January 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland - January 10.

text.p: Following are the highlights of stories reported in the Irish press on Friday:

-- Freezing weather and an influenza outbreak have forced hospitals to cancel hundreds of non-emergency admissions. -- The government is facing a major challenge from unions at state transport company CIE over a restructuring plan involving 786 job cuts
-- The government is to send a team to Moscow to argue against an extension of Russia's beef ban on Irish cattle because of the BSE scare
-- A French judge said 50 French children were contaminaed with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, the human equivalent of mad cow disease
-- The Examiner Groupt has pulled out of the consortium for Radio Ireland, which is due to start in March.
